card.name: Aircraft and airline descriptions in news
card.fires_on: Words inside passages about airplanes, jet engines, airlines or ships, especially modifiers and linking words just before an aircraft or vessel noun or verb. Examples are 'newer', 'long-range' and 'two-engine' before 'jetliners'.

modes.label: Modifiers before jetliners
modes.description: Adjectives and hyphenated parts that describe aircraft or engines, such as newer, long-range, two-engine.
modes.example: especially on<< newer>> long-range two-engine jetliners.

modes.label: Verbs and links in aviation or ship stories
modes.description: Small words after a plane, airline or liner as subject, leading to what it does.
modes.example: Planes belonging to the airline, which hasn't been identified,<< would>> land at Montrose

card.writes: It nudges the model toward words about operating or directing vehicles, and away from carrier and ramp words.
card.plain: It lights up in stories about planes, jets and airlines, on the words that lead into the aircraft or what it does.
